BEFORE YOU UPLOAD

Please review how OptiScale handles your project during analysis and benchmarking.

PROJECT USE & EXECUTION
01 YOUR PROJECT

You should only upload source code and project files that you own or are authorized to use and submit.

02 AI ANALYSIS

Your uploaded project may be analyzed by OptiScale's AI system to identify potential performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

03 ISOLATED EXECUTION ISOLATED ENVIRONMENT

For benchmarking, the project may be prepared and executed in an isolated environment with resource limits applied during testing.

04 REMOVE SENSITIVE DATA

Do not upload passwords, API keys, access tokens, private credentials, or sensitive personal information.

⚠ REMOVE SECRETS BEFORE UPLOAD
05 PERFORMANCE TESTING

Benchmark results are intended to demonstrate application performance under the configured test workload. Results may vary under different environments and workloads.

DEMO / PROTOTYPE NOTICE

OptiScale is currently a hackathon prototype. Some analysis, optimization, and benchmark workflows may use simulated or demonstration data.
